newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores in the four day Supersport Series cricket matches on Saturday.
In Durban (day three): Boland 133 and 201 (G.Gilder 5-60), Natal 198 and 137-2 (D.Watson 51 not out). Natal won by eight wickets.
In Kimberley (day two): Free State 493 (B.Dippenaar 50, L.Wilkinson 75, C.Craven 109, B.Player 133 not out), Griqualand West 145-2 (M.Arthur 57, M.Gidley 52)
In Cape Town (day two): Border 210 and 99-6 (B.Schultz 4-46), Western Province 290 (D.Haynes 99, C.Matthews 96, M.Ntini 6-49)
In Johannesburg (day two): Transvaal 334 (D.Laing 128, A,Hall 60) and 3-0, Eastern Province 261 (G.Morgan 65 not out, R.Veenstra 5-36)
